name: Path Characterization Equivalence
hypotheses: Finite connected graph; the obstruction criterion assumes a partial cube.
statement: The path, degree-two tree, and two-obstruction criteria define the same class.
proof: A finite connected acyclic graph of maximum degree at most two is a path. The tree obstruction excludes cycles by $C_4$; within a tree, a vertex of degree at least three supplies a convex $K_{1,3}$, while paths are closed under pc-minors.
